Automatically run state export after each Cascade response to keep dashboard state fresh.

Schema-agnostic triple store with EQL-S queries, already in the codebase. No external dependencies needed.
SQLite tables, JSON files, external graph DB (Neo4j)
Ship dashboard as static HTML with state.json
Zero build step, works with any static file server. Tailwind CDN for styling.
React/Svelte SPA, VS Code webview, Electron app
Use Bun WebSocket server for realtime updates
Bun has native WebSocket support, low overhead. Hooks push events via HTTP POST, server broadcasts to clients.
Use file-based intent inbox for dashboard → Cascade
No Cascade API exists for programmatic messaging. Hooks read inbox on next fire and surface via show_output.
Direct API (not available), clipboard injection, MCP server
All hook console output starts with [HQ] or [HQ Guard]
Entity IDs use type:slug format (e.g., task:scaffold, file:hooks/tql-init.ts)
Always use safeQuery() wrapper that returns [] on error, never throw from EQL-S queries in generators
Guard blocks writes to node_modules/, .git/, lockfiles
